messages.author: 04efeca67d1815af
messages.subject: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
parts:
Dear all, 

Just requesting a bit of help in determining the units for the data from the variable labelled AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO

So, my understanding is that this is measuring the average MVPA in 5 second epochs, bouts of 10 mins, where ENMO is above the threshold of 93.2mg for 80% of the time. But that is where i come unstuck as I would be expecting a whole number (and not very large) from this variable e.g. value of 3 = 3x10 mins bouts above the threshold (therefore 30 minutes MVPA in total). However, my data is showing fractions of large numbers (up to 80.69) so this interpretation has to be incorrect.  

Could anyone interpret for me what a value of 80.69 means? 

Kind regards, 

Kiya

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
parts:
Hi Kiya,
Actually, this variable does not have to be multiple of 10 in case this is what you refer to. Bouts of 10 min include activity maintained for at least 10 min, as minimum. If the activity is maintained for more time, it is also part of this variable. So, this is also the explanation for why this variable is not an integer number.

Consider also that the variable is a mean of the valid days, so if you have 4 valid days and 3 bouts of exactly 10 min, this mean will not be an integer.

Best,
Jairo

messages.author: 04efeca67d1815af
messages.subject: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
parts:
Thanks Jairo. That has explained it perfectly for me.

Kind regards,

Kiya

Hi Lydia, 

You will find it in the part 2 summary, though the default thresholds are 100 and 120 if I am not mistaken.
Part 5 should allow you to extract similar estimates given the correct criteria (they look something like dur_MVPA...). You will find descriptions for all variables and criteria options in the manual.

Regards,

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Units of measurement for AD_MVPA_E5S_B10M80%_T93.2_ENMO
parts:
Good to hear you found it Lydia,
part2_summary.csv has the AD_, WD_, etc added to the filenames, while
part2_daysummary.csv does not.
This is because AD_, WD_ refer to how values are summarised
(aggregated) across days, which is only meaningful at a person
(recording) level and not at a day level.
Vincent
